summary: Complete initial independent audit of all 441 Chinese source units, 49 temporal or active-hint items, and eight extracted people. Explicit Hongwu and Jiajing regnal-year claims, including the legendary ritual allusions, are supported. Chen Xiangdao is only identified as a Northern Song author, so his extracted AD 1042–1093 interval remains a source-specific research hold. No source or canonical extraction was edited.
